messages.subject: show knitr code in tex?
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to put together a short knitr intro for my students, and I want to show them exactly what to type in Rstudio. 

Essentially, I want to put this chunk within a knitr chunk
<<my-label, eval=TRUE>>=
x <- seq(1:10)
x
@

but it doesn't seem to be working if I do

<<knitrexample, eval = FALSE>>=
<<my-label, eval=TRUE>>=
x <- seq(1:10)
x
@
@

I tried to use cat() as a workaround, but I was wondering if there is a more straightforward way to do this?
